description: SpType -> T_eff and SpType -> BC_V calibration tables, for the star luminosity chain SpType -> T_eff -> BC -> M_bol -> L. These are CALIBRATED mean values for a spectral type, NOT observations of any individual star; the page must label them as calibration, not measurement.

identity.note: solar anchors are INPUTS to the chain, not values from the table; see PROVENANCE for the derivation.

source.name: Mamajek, "A Modern Mean Dwarf Stellar Color and Effective Temperature Sequence"
source.author: Eric E. Mamajek (University of Rochester)
source.author_request: the file asks to be emailed if the table is used in research

source_scope.covers: luminosity class V (dwarfs) only, spectral classes O3-M9 plus L/T/Y
source_scope.bc_v_missing_note: the source prints '...' (no value) in the BC_V column for these keys; they are kept in the T_eff table and OMITTED from the BC table - not filled with any substitute.

lookup_rules: 1. exact: raw SpType string equals a key of sptype_to_teff_K / sptype_to_bc_v_mag.
2. normalized_obs_note: strip a trailing non-MK note (var / SB / ... / :) and re-match. These notes do not change the MK type.
3. normalized_peculiarity: strip a trailing MK peculiarity code (p/m/e/n) that follows the luminosity class, then re-match.
4. unresolved: anything else. A composite ('+' or 'comp'), a luminosity-class range ('-' or '/'), or a string with no class-V classification is NOT guessed - it stays missing.
